title: Rav Ami bar Ada of Harpanya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.59b.13-14) he asked Rabbah, who answered him with a teaching in Rav’s name. Rav Nachman said to them: “Do not listen to him; thus said…,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rabbah answers in Rav’s name. Rav Nachman then tells the listeners to disregard that answer and quotes Rav Ada in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=584&lang=en) compares this sequence with a different chain in Yuchasin. The fragment at the end of Hyman’s notice is preserved in the body.
